description: Devil's-advocate re-probe of 5 LIVE-VERIFIED endpoints (stride=5 sample, LV[10-14]) using different probe kinds than the originals. Goal: find disagreements between TRUTH.openapi.yaml and live Clockify behavior.

results.key_finding: GET returns 405 'Request method GET is not supported' — exactly as TRUTH.yaml documents. POST with impossible userId filter returns {count:0, requests:[]} — empty-envelope shape matches TRUTH.yaml schema. No discrepancy.
GET with far-future date window (2099) returns bare [] with HTTP 200 — confirms GET path live and bare-array shape holds for empty results. TRUTH.yaml correct.

secondary_finding.description: Server accepts page-size up to 5000 (returns 400 above that). TRUTH.yaml documents maximum:200 for page-size on this path. The 200 cap is a typed-tool constraint, not a live API constraint.
secondary_finding.severity: informational — tool-layer cap, not an API bug

results.key_finding: Independent GET returned 200 with all documented keys (defaults, exportFields, labels). tax=2500 minor-units claim verified. No required query params confirmed. TRUTH.yaml fully accurate.

secondary_finding.description: TRUTH.yaml 'labels' sub-schema is underspecified — documents only free-form description, but live response contains 17 specific named keys (amount, billFrom, billTo, description, discount, dueDate, issueDate, itemType, notes, paid, quantity, subtotal, tax, tax2, total, totalAmount, unitPrice).

results.key_finding: GET without userLocale → 400 'Required request parameter userLocale... is not present'. GET with userLocale=en → %PDF binary causes JSON parse error. Both behaviors match TRUTH.yaml exactly.

secondary_finding.description: Typed tool clockify_invoices_export silently defaults user_locale to 'en-US' when omitted. This tool-layer default masks the API's required parameter from MCP callers. TRUTH.yaml is accurate about the raw API contract but does not note the tool default.
secondary_finding.severity: informational — tool behavior note worth adding to TRUTH.yaml x-tool-note

results.key_finding: Non-existent userId ('<redacted-id:1aaa799929>') returns HTTP 200 {balances:[], count:0} — NOT a 404. Clockify silently returns empty results for unknown userIds.

secondary_findings.description: Non-existent userId: silent 200 empty envelope rather than 404. TRUTH.yaml only documents 200 response — technically correct, but the silent-200-for-missing-entity behavior is not noted.
secondary_findings.severity: informational — callers cannot distinguish user-not-found from user-has-no-balances

secondary_findings.description: Page parameter is server-capped at 1000: page=99999 returns 400 'must be less than or equal to 1000'. TRUTH.yaml documents page with default:1 but NO maximum constraint.

actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.recommended_fix: Add maximum: 1000 to page parameter schema

actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.gap: No documentation that non-existent userId returns 200 empty rather than 404
actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.recommended_fix: Add x-note: 'unknown userId returns 200 {balances:[], count:0} not 404'

actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.gap: Typed tool clockify_invoices_export defaults user_locale to en-US when omitted — not documented
actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.recommended_fix: Add x-tool-note to TRUTH.yaml: 'clockify_invoices_export defaults user_locale to en-US when omitted'

actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.gap: labels object sub-keys not enumerated in schema (17 known keys)
actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.recommended_fix: Add named properties to labels schema: amount, billFrom, billTo, description, discount, dueDate, issueDate, itemType, notes, paid, quantity, subtotal, tax, tax2, total, totalAmount, unitPrice

actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.gap: page-size maximum in TRUTH.yaml is 200 but server accepts up to 5000
actionable_truth_yaml_gaps.recommended_fix: Update page-size maximum from 200 to 5000 with note that typed tool enforces 200

overall_assessment: All 5 LIVE-VERIFIED endpoints remain CONFIRMED. Zero demotions. Five informational/minor spec gaps identified: (1) page max:1000 missing on time-off/balance/user; (2) silent-200 for unknown userId undocumented; (3) invoices/export typed-tool user_locale default undocumented; (4) invoices/settings labels sub-keys not enumerated; (5) user/time-entries page-size server cap is 5000 not 200. None of these gaps rise to a demotion — they are precision improvements to the spec.
